issue_comments.body:
[A10] **Round 2: R739-1 and R740-1 on PR #97. Executor [A707b].**

Both reviews are NEGATIVE, with MINOR findings only. Fix them all in one round:
- **R740-1 F1 = R739-1 F3:** wrong claims about publication timing. Correct them against the RTL lines the reviews cite.
- **R740-1 F2 = R739-1 F4:** stale constants escape the new gate. Extend `scripts/check_docs.py` so that each constant in the table is checked against its source. A planted stale value must fail.
- **R740-1 F3 = R739-1 F5:** protocol values are still duplicated. Hold each value once, in the constants table, and link to it from every other page.
- **R740-1 F4 = R739-1 F1:** the Follow_Up clause reference is wrong. Cite the right clause of IEEE 802.1AS-2011 with Cor1/Cor2.
- **R739-1 F2:** `docs/history/v1/RESOURCE_DELTAS_2026_10.md:32` must link the measurement reports themselves, using label-free visible text, as R739-1 requires. The `docs/history` archive rule is "preserve commit references for reproducibility". This one-line repair restores the reference; it adds no new content.

Add commits on top of `86073476`, with no rebase. Re-run every docs and CI-hygiene gate at the head. A delta review follows.
